result.why.acceptance_unverified: The reviewer passed the work, but not every condition was shown to hold (see Acceptance), so Bridge does not deliver it as passed.
result.proof.no_git: No work proof: this project has no Git, so Bridge cannot list what changed and did not check the scope.
result.proof.start_lost: The Git history or branch changed after the run started, so there is nothing sound to compare against.

result.section.unverified: Changes outside the scope that could not be attributed to this run
result.why.start_point_lost: The Git history was rewritten or the branch switched after the run started; Bridge stopped instead of comparing against a start that no longer exists.
result.proof.records_changed: No work proof: the run's work-proof records changed or no longer match what Bridge kept, so the list of changes cannot be trusted.
result.proof.records_only: Work proof from Git, checked against the records Bridge wrote; any process running as the same user could have rewritten them.
result.why.evidence_unavailable: The change evidence could not be read: the list of changes Bridge made from Git for the review was missing or not valid JSON, so Bridge stopped instead of reviewing without it.
result.why.evidence_changed: A work-proof record Bridge had sealed was changed during the run, so Bridge stopped instead of judging the work from it.
result.why.version_changed: The project changed while the reviewer was reading it, so the version the tests ran on is not the version that was reviewed. Another run working in this folder, or a person, may have changed files. The work was not passed.
result.why.version_changed.test: The project changed after the tests ran on it and before the reviewer read it, so the tested version and the version to be reviewed differ. Another run working in this folder, or a person, may have changed files. The work was not passed and no review was run.
result.proof.records_unconfirmed: No work proof: this run was resumed after its controller stopped, and the call records the earlier controller wrote cannot be confirmed.
result.why.evidence_unconfirmable: The run was resumed after an interruption; the records of its earlier calls cannot be confirmed, so no model call was started.
result.why.scope_unverified: Some changes outside the scope could not be attributed to this run (another run's record, a human edit, or a commit between calls), so Bridge does not deliver the work as passed; see the unverified changes below.
result.why.contract.problems: The contract lacks what a work order must say, so the writer did not take it:
